duplicados.bajada: Profiles that look like the same person. Spotted by normalised URL, handle and name similarity. They are never merged on their own.
duplicados.borrarBajada: It is deleted from the database and cannot be undone. It is safe because they took part in no campaign: there is no history to lose. {sobrevive} is left alone.
duplicados.descartarBajada: They are marked as reviewed and leave this list. Nothing is deleted or merged: you are only saying they are not the same person.
duplicados.descartarTitulo: {cantidad, plural, one {Dismiss the pair} other {Dismiss # pairs}}
duplicados.fusionBajada: Everything from {absorbido} moves to {sobrevive}: profiles, niches, tags and campaigns. {absorbido} is archived with a note saying who it was merged into. Nothing is deleted.
duplicados.fusionConflictos: {cantidad} were not moved: they were already in that campaign
duplicados.fusionarBajada: Only the ones that are the same account are merged: same URL or same handle on the same network. In each pair the card with more history (profiles and campaigns) is kept and the other is archived with a note saying who it was merged into — nothing is deleted. The ones that were paired only because the names look alike are left alone, and we tell you which they are so you can look at them one by one.
duplicados.fusionarConfirmar: Merge the ones that are the same account
duplicados.fusionarTitulo: {cantidad, plural, one {Merge the pair} other {Merge # pairs}}
duplicados.marcarRevisadoBajada: You are confirming they are not the same person. The pair stops appearing in the list, but it stays on record.
duplicados.noSePuedeBorrar: {nombre} cannot be deleted: they took part in {cantidad, plural, one {# campaign} other {# campaigns}}.
duplicados.notaRevisado: Reviewed: they are not the same person.
duplicados.seConservaAviso: The other one is archived with its data; it is not deleted.
duplicados.vacioBajada: Everything spotted has already been resolved.

descubiertos.avisoMonedas: Amounts are shown per currency and are not added together: converting them at a made-up exchange rate would give a figure nobody can verify.
descubiertos.bajada: Profiles the searches brought in. Searching here costs nothing: this is already paid for.
descubiertos.comoCambiaronBajada: A row is written every time a provider measures them and the number changed. Over time this answers for free whether they are growing or falling.
descubiertos.filtroBuscarPista: Name, @handle or something from their bio
descubiertos.historialDeTrabajoBajada: Campaigns they took part in and what they were paid. It is read from each campaign, so it always matches what the campaign shows.
descubiertos.pasarBajada: A card is created for each one, with their handle, their followers and their engagement. From there they can be added to a campaign. Anyone already in the roster is tied to the existing card instead of being duplicated.
descubiertos.pasarTitulo: {cantidad, plural, one {Move this profile to the roster} other {Move # profiles to the roster}}
descubiertos.sinCoincidenciasBajada: Try loosening a filter. If we really do not have them, we have to go out and look: that does cost.
descubiertos.sinCoincidenciasTitulo: None of the ones we have match that
descubiertos.sinHistoriaBajada: It needs another search to find them again with different numbers.
descubiertos.sinPadronBajada: Import them from a search to be able to add them to a campaign. From then on, everything that happens with them is written here.
descubiertos.sinTrabajoBajada: Once they join a campaign, they show up here with their payments.
descubiertos.sinTrabajoTitulo: They have not worked with us yet

scouting.aQuienBuscasAyuda: A topic and a network. Everything you filter is checked against the data the network returns: if a creator is missing the datum, it is flagged, not discarded.
scouting.alMenosAyuda: Of the audience has to meet what you chose.
scouting.audienciaRealAyuda: How much of that audience is not fake accounts.
scouting.avisoAudiencia: Before you use these: today the provider has audience demographics almost only for the United States. Measured on 2026-08-27: there are 110,177 Argentine creators between 10k and 100k, but asking in addition that their audience be Argentine leaves 9. For clients here it is better to leave these on “does not matter” and filter by the creator’s country, above.
scouting.bajada: Find new people through an outside provider. It costs per record, so we always tell you what it will come to before running it. Before spending, look in Discovered: that is already paid for.
scouting.bioMencionaAyuda: A word or phrase, exactly as it appears in the bio.
scouting.campoModo: What do you want to do
scouting.cancelarBajada: The provider is asked to stop. What it already collected is charged anyway.
scouting.enMarcha: Scouting is under way. We will tell you when it finishes.
scouting.erMinimoAyuda: The average of their recent posts, when the network reports it.
scouting.filtroComprobado: It is checked against what the network returned.
scouting.filtroEnOrigen: The provider filtered on this before returning, so every one of them meets it.
scouting.grupoAudienciaBajada: Who the audience is, not who posts. It is what decides whether a campaign lands.
scouting.grupoCreadorBajada: Where they are and what their bio says.
scouting.grupoRendimientoBajada: Followers and engagement read from the network.
scouting.limiteAyuda: {proveedor} · {porMil} profiles · this search costs up to {total}

scouting.noSePuedeEjecutarVarios: It cannot be run, for two reasons

scouting.recuentoCierre: . None is discarded on its own: you have them all here.

scouting.seCorto: We asked for the search to be stopped.
scouting.sinBusquedasBajada: Put one together above to get started.
scouting.sinBusquedasTitulo: You have not run any search yet
scouting.sinCampana: Do not tie it to any campaign
scouting.sinClientesBajada: Scouting looks for profiles for a specific client. Create the first one and come back.
scouting.sinPerfilesBajada: The provider delivered records, but none had the minimum data to build a profile — a handle and a link. The spend was charged anyway. If it happens again, try another platform or tell the team: it may be the provider and not the search.
scouting.sinPerfilesTitulo: This search left no profile saved.
scouting.sinPermisoBajada: This feature costs per use, so it is limited to the agency. Ask an admin for it.
scouting.sinPermisoTitulo: You do not have permission to run scouting

scouting.yaGuardados: All of these are already saved in Discovered, with the words you used and their metrics: you can search them there whenever you want, free. Importing is something else: moving them to the roster so they can be added to a campaign.

resultados.borrarBajada: The metrics recorded for this deliverable are lost. If the publication was taken down, mark it cancelled instead of deleting it.
resultados.fuenteAyuda: Required if you record any number: in three months nobody remembers.
resultados.huecoNadaPublicado: None of the recorded deliverables is marked as published.
resultados.huecoSinEntregas: No publication has been recorded yet.
resultados.huecoSinInteracciones: {cantidad} have no interactions recorded at all.
resultados.huecoSinLinksMedidos: There are no tracked links, so there is no way to know how many people went to the site.
resultados.huecoSinViews: {sin} of {de} publications have no views recorded.
resultados.huecosCierre: None of this counts as zero. The totals above are over what is recorded, and the AI report will say so too.
resultados.linkCreado: Link created. Copy it and pass it on to the influencer.
resultados.linksMedidosBajada: The link goes through us before reaching the client's site, so the click is a fact and not something we are told. It does not identify people: distinct visitors are counted per day and the IP address is never stored.
resultados.noSeCopio: It could not be copied. Select it by hand.
resultados.noSeCreoLink: The link could not be created.
resultados.noSeGuardoEntrega: The deliverable could not be saved.
resultados.primeroConfirmados: There first have to be confirmed profiles in the campaign.
resultados.publicacionesBajada: What each one published and what it measured. Leave blank what you do not know: an empty field means “nobody recorded it”, and that is different from zero.
resultados.sinEntregas: No publication has been recorded yet. Until there are, there are no results to report.
resultados.sinLinks: There are no tracked links yet. Without them there is no way to know how many people went from the post to the site.
resultados.tasaSinDatos: data is missing to work it out
resultados.tasaSobreAmbas: over the ones that have both

objetivos.bajada: What was promised and whether it is being met. Goals can only be set on things the product can really measure.
objetivos.bajadaCompacta: What the campaign set out to do, and how it is going against what was measured.
objetivos.cerradaAviso: The campaign is closed, so anything below its goal shows as not reached rather than “on track”.
objetivos.expObjetivoEnCero: The goal is zero, so there is nothing to compare against.
objetivos.expPorEncima: Met, and beyond: {pct}% of the goal.
objetivos.expQuedoEn: It ended at {pct}% of the goal: {falta} short.
objetivos.expSePaso: It went over the cap by {exceso}.
objetivos.expSinDato: It cannot be assessed yet: nobody recorded {metrica}.
objetivos.expVaEn: It is at {pct}% of the goal. {falta} to go.
objetivos.fuenteALCANCE_ESTIMADO: The sum of the approved profiles’ followers. It is an estimate, not people reached.
objetivos.fuenteALCANCE_REAL: The reach each publication reported, entered by hand by the agency.
objetivos.fuenteCLICS: Clicks on the tracked links. It is the only thing on this list that we measure ourselves.
objetivos.fuenteINTERACCIONES: Likes, comments, shares and saves of the recorded publications.
objetivos.fuenteINVERSION_EN_TALENTO: The sum of the fees agreed with the confirmed profiles.
objetivos.fuenteVISUALIZACIONES: The views each publication reported, entered by hand.
objetivos.interno: Internal: the client does not see it.
objetivos.noSeBorro: The goal could not be deleted.
objetivos.noSeGuardo: The goal could not be saved.
objetivos.porQueAyuda: Six months from now this lets you discuss the goal, not only the result.
objetivos.quitarBajada: The number and the reason it was chosen are lost. The measured result is left alone.
objetivos.sinObjetivos: There are no goals yet. Without one, the report can tell what happened but not whether it was good.
objetivos.sinObjetivosCompacto: The agency has not set goals for this campaign yet.
objetivos.verNoAlcanzados: {cantidad, plural, one {# goal was not reached} other {# goals were not reached}}.
objetivos.verNoAlcanzadosConSinDato: {cantidad, plural, one {# goal was not reached} other {# goals were not reached}}, and {sinDato} with no data to assess.
objetivos.verRestoEnCamino: {cumplidos} of {total} met, the rest on track.
objetivos.verSinDatos: There is nothing to say yet: {sinDato} of {total} goals have no data recorded.
